description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for rendering a line chart representing weekly expense points. It includes custom painting logic for the chart's lines, points, labels, and background fills, emphasizing expense trends over weeks.

classes.name: _XAxisLabels
classes.description: A widget that displays x-axis labels for weekly data points.

classes.name: _LinePainter
classes.description: Custom painter responsible for drawing the expense line chart, including the lines, points, filled area, and grid lines.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the ExpenseLineChart widget, rendering the chart and labels or a placeholder if no data.

methods.name: _XAxisLabels.build
methods.description: Builds the widget displaying week labels on the x-axis.

methods.name: _LinePainter.paint
methods.description: Implements the drawing logic for the line chart, including the lines, gradient fill, points, and baseline grid.

methods.name: shouldRepaint
methods.description: Determines if the custom painter should repaint based on changes to data or color.
